panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Reachable nodes out of those Kubernetes discovery found.

panels.title: Attention
panels.description: Rules firing across the fleet — the row count of the table below.

targets.expr:
count(
label_replace(label_replace((max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 0) + 1, "severity", "down", "", ""), "reason", "Talos API unreachable", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace((count by (node) (max by (node, service) ((talos_service_running == 0)) or max by (node, service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) > 0) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "down", "", ""), "reason", "services not healthy", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, stage) (talos_machine_stage_info) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_machine_ready) == 0) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "down", "", ""), "reason", "machine not ready at stage $1", "stage", "(.+)"), "stage", "", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace((max by (node) (talos_time_synced) == 0) + 1 and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "warn", "", ""), "reason", "clock not synced", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace((max by (node) (talos_machine_volumes_not_ready) > 0) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "down", "", ""), "reason", "volumes not ready", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace((max by (node) (talos_diagnostics) > 0) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "warn", "", ""), "reason", "diagnostics raised", "", "")
  or
label_replace(label_replace(floor((max by (node) (talos_node_uptime_seconds) < 3600) / 60) and on (node) (max by (node) (talos_node_up) == 1), "severity", "warn", "", ""), "reason", "rebooted in the last hour", "", "")
) or vector(0)

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Services stopped, or running and failing a check they publish. No-check services are excluded.

targets.expr: count(max by (node, service) ((talos_service_running == 0)) or max by (node, service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Busiest node
panels.description: The node with the highest CPU usage, and that same node's 1-minute load.

targets.expr: max by (node) (talos_node_load1) and on (node) topk(1, max by (node) (talos_node_cpu_usage_ratio{cpu="all"}))

panels.title: Images
panels.description: Distinct Image Factory schematics. More than one is not wrong, but check it after an upgrade.

panels.title: GPUs
panels.description: GPUs found in sysfs and how many nodes carry them.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Reachable against discovered. A gap between them is a node that went away.

panels.title: CPU per node
panels.description: Node-total CPU, one line per node.

panels.title: Load per node
panels.description: 1-minute load per node. Read it against each node's thread count below.

panels.title: System status
panels.description: Per-node state: stage, ready, services, load, clock, volumes and diagnostics.

targets.expr: count by (node) (max by (node, service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 1) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or (count by (node) (talos_service_running) * 0)

count by (node) (max by (node, service) ((talos_service_running == 0)) or max by (node, service) (((talos_service_running == 1) and (talos_service_healthy == 0) and (talos_service_health_unknown == 0)))) or (count by (node) (talos_service_running) * 0)

panels.title: Fleet capacity
panels.description: The totals of the inventory below.

targets.expr: sum(max by (node, device) (talos_block_disk_size_bytes) * on (node, device) group_left () max by (node, device) (talos_block_disk_info{attachment="local"}))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: The node inventory. Storage counts physically attached disks only.

targets.expr: max by (node, ip, roles, kube_version) (talos_node_k8s_info) or ((max by (node) (talos_node_up) * 0 - 1) unless on (node) talos_node_k8s_info)
sum by (node) (max by (node, device) (talos_block_disk_size_bytes) * on (node, device) group_left () max by (node, device) (talos_block_disk_info{attachment="local"}))
